items.title: Google將AI Mode廣告擴展至新加坡等十個市場
items.title_en: Google expands AI Mode ads to ten markets, including Singapore
items.summary: Google於10月28日宣布，AI Mode廣告正擴展至十個市場，包括新加坡、馬來西亞、印度及澳洲；美國同時推出可出現在追問中的multiturn ads。
items.summary_en: Google announced on October 28 that AI Mode ads are expanding to ten markets, including Singapore, Malaysia, India and Australia. Multiturn ads are launching in the US.
items.why: 面向東南亞的品牌可把AI對話搜尋納入媒體檢視，並逐市場確認實際展示及可取得的報表。
items.why_en: Brands serving Southeast Asia can review conversational search within their media plans and confirm market-level delivery and reporting.
items.next_step: 先向Google帳戶團隊確認適用活動及推出進度，再檢視產品資料與落地頁是否回答較長的比較問題。
items.next_step_en: Confirm eligible campaigns and rollout with Google, then review whether product feeds and landing pages answer detailed comparison questions.
highlights: 其餘市場為加拿大、肯尼亞、新西蘭、尼日利亞、巴基斯坦及菲律賓。
巴西、墨西哥及英國列入2026年第四季擴展計劃；廣告標示為Sponsored。
highlights_en: The other markets are Canada, Kenya, New Zealand, Nigeria, Pakistan and the Philippines.
Brazil, Mexico and the UK are planned for Q4 2026; ads carry a Sponsored label.
items.detail:
Google於10月28日宣布，AI Mode廣告正擴展至十個市場，包括新加坡、馬來西亞、印度及澳洲；美國同時推出可出現在追問中的multiturn ads。

其餘市場為加拿大、肯尼亞、新西蘭、尼日利亞、巴基斯坦及菲律賓。

巴西、墨西哥及英國列入2026年第四季擴展計劃；廣告標示為Sponsored。

面向東南亞的品牌可把AI對話搜尋納入媒體檢視，並逐市場確認實際展示及可取得的報表。

先向Google帳戶團隊確認適用活動及推出進度，再檢視產品資料與落地頁是否回答較長的比較問題。

公告未列香港；美國追問廣告不等同已擴展至所有市場。點擊率比較屬Google內部資料，本刊不作獨立成效結論。
items.detail_en:
Google announced on October 28 that AI Mode ads are expanding to ten markets, including Singapore, Malaysia, India and Australia. Multiturn ads are launching in the US.

The other markets are Canada, Kenya, New Zealand, Nigeria, Pakistan and the Philippines.

Brazil, Mexico and the UK are planned for Q4 2026; ads carry a Sponsored label.

Brands serving Southeast Asia can review conversational search within their media plans and confirm market-level delivery and reporting.

Confirm eligible campaigns and rollout with Google, then review whether product feeds and landing pages answer detailed comparison questions.

Hong Kong is not listed. US multiturn ads are distinct from the international rollout; internal click-rate comparisons are not independently validated.

items.title: NIQ與Google合作推進代理式購物，連結商品、庫存與行銷量度
items.title_en: NIQ and Google partner on agentic commerce, product data and measurement
items.summary: NIQ與Google於10月29日公布合作，擬把零售及商品情報接入AI購物生態，並推進Meridian與NIQ Cadence的行銷組合模型整合。
items.summary_en: NIQ and Google announced a collaboration on October 29 to connect retail and product intelligence with AI commerce and integrate Meridian into NIQ Cadence.
items.why: 對零售與消費品牌，商品資料完整度、門市可售資訊及增量量度可放在同一個評估框架。
items.why_en: Retail and consumer brands can assess product completeness, local availability and incremental measurement together.
items.next_step: 盤點商品識別碼、門市庫存更新及銷售資料可用性，再向供應商確認試點範圍與整合時間。
items.next_step_en: Audit product identifiers, stock updates and sales-data access, then confirm pilot scope and integration timing.
highlights: 合作重點包括商品探索及本地供應情況；具體項目與里程碑仍待後續公布。
NIQ亦指定Google Cloud為主要AI及雲端服務供應商之一，並計劃向全球員工部署Gemini for business。
highlights_en: The commerce work targets product discovery and local availability; specific initiatives and milestones will follow.
NIQ is naming Google Cloud a primary AI and cloud provider and plans workforce-wide Gemini for business deployment.
items.detail:
NIQ與Google於10月29日公布合作，擬把零售及商品情報接入AI購物生態，並推進Meridian與NIQ Cadence的行銷組合模型整合。

合作重點包括商品探索及本地供應情況；具體項目與里程碑仍待後續公布。

NIQ亦指定Google Cloud為主要AI及雲端服務供應商之一，並計劃向全球員工部署Gemini for business。

對零售與消費品牌，商品資料完整度、門市可售資訊及增量量度可放在同一個評估框架。

盤點商品識別碼、門市庫存更新及銷售資料可用性，再向供應商確認試點範圍與整合時間。

這是合作公告，並非全部功能已全面開放；公告未證明任何品牌已因合作獲得銷售增長。
items.detail_en:
NIQ and Google announced a collaboration on October 29 to connect retail and product intelligence with AI commerce and integrate Meridian into NIQ Cadence.

The commerce work targets product discovery and local availability; specific initiatives and milestones will follow.

NIQ is naming Google Cloud a primary AI and cloud provider and plans workforce-wide Gemini for business deployment.

Retail and consumer brands can assess product completeness, local availability and incremental measurement together.

Audit product identifiers, stock updates and sales-data access, then confirm pilot scope and integration timing.

This is a partnership announcement, not universal product availability or evidence of sales uplift.

items.title: Canva推出Brush設計編輯模型，先供Pro訂戶使用
items.title_en: Canva introduces Brush for supported design edits on Pro plans
items.summary: Canva介紹由Canva Research開發的Brush視覺語言模型，先為Canva Pro訂戶提供支援的設計編輯；更廣泛開放仍在後續安排。
items.summary_en: Canva introduced Brush, a vision-language model from Canva Research, for supported design edits by Canva Pro subscribers. Wider availability is planned.
items.why: 創意團隊可評估批量改版及多尺寸延伸，品牌一致性仍需用已批准素材逐頁覆核。

items.next_step_en: Try a title and format change on an approved deck; inspect Chinese text, logos, colors and elements that should stay unchanged.
highlights: 用戶可在Canva AI選擇Brush，要求跨頁改字或把設計改成另一種渠道格式。
Canva表示輸出元素仍可手動編輯；Brand Kit支援、參考附件及大量圖片版面改善仍在開發。
highlights_en: Users can select Brush in Canva AI for changes across pages or adaptation to another channel format.
Canva says elements remain editable; Brand Kit support, attachment references and image-heavy layout improvements are still in development.
items.detail:
Canva介紹由Canva Research開發的Brush視覺語言模型，先為Canva Pro訂戶提供支援的設計編輯；更廣泛開放仍在後續安排。

用戶可在Canva AI選擇Brush，要求跨頁改字或把設計改成另一種渠道格式。

Canva表示輸出元素仍可手動編輯；Brand Kit支援、參考附件及大量圖片版面改善仍在開發。

創意團隊可評估批量改版及多尺寸延伸，品牌一致性仍需用已批准素材逐頁覆核。

用一份已批准的多頁簡報試改標題及尺寸，檢查中文字、Logo、色彩與未要求修改的元素。

速度及成本數字屬Canva內部測試，本刊未重現；不把尚未推出的Brand Kit支援寫成現有功能。
items.detail_en:
Canva introduced Brush, a vision-language model from Canva Research, for supported design edits by Canva Pro subscribers. Wider availability is planned.

Canva says elements remain editable; Brand Kit support, attachment references and image-heavy layout improvements are still in development.

items.title: 香港Payment Asia推出ARCS行銷工具，邀指定餐飲商戶參與試行
items.title_en: Hong Kong’s Payment Asia introduces ARCS with a selected F&B pilot
items.summary: Payment Asia於10月29日宣布ARCS市場推廣工具及商戶健康指數MHI，並邀請指定餐飲商戶參與試行。
items.summary_en: Payment Asia announced ARCS and the Merchant Health Index on October 29, inviting selected food and beverage merchants into a pilot.
items.why: 香港中小企可評估內容到付款的接駁方式，並把素材審核、支付追蹤及資料使用條款一併檢視。
items.why_en: Hong Kong SMEs can assess the content-to-payment journey alongside creative review, payment tracking and data-use terms.
items.next_step: 餐飲商戶可查詢試行資格、收費及資料要求，先用真實產品資料製作小規模活動並驗收付款路徑。
items.next_step_en: Ask about pilot eligibility, pricing and data requirements, then validate a small campaign and its payment journey.
highlights: 公司表示ARCS可生成面向香港消費者的文案及產品圖片，配合預設提示與活動模板。
活動可加入Payment Asia付款連結；MHI另以商戶及交易相關資料產生健康評分。
highlights_en: The company says ARCS generates localized copy and product imagery for Hong Kong consumers, with prompts and campaign templates.
Campaigns include a Payment Asia payment link; MHI separately scores merchant health using business and transaction-related data.
items.detail:
Payment Asia於10月29日宣布ARCS市場推廣工具及商戶健康指數MHI，並邀請指定餐飲商戶參與試行。

公司表示ARCS可生成面向香港消費者的文案及產品圖片，配合預設提示與活動模板。

活動可加入Payment Asia付款連結；MHI另以商戶及交易相關資料產生健康評分。

香港中小企可評估內容到付款的接駁方式，並把素材審核、支付追蹤及資料使用條款一併檢視。

餐飲商戶可查詢試行資格、收費及資料要求，先用真實產品資料製作小規模活動並驗收付款路徑。

試行不代表所有商戶可即用；本刊未驗證銷售提升或健康評分的預測準確度。
items.detail_en:
Payment Asia announced ARCS and the Merchant Health Index on October 29, inviting selected food and beverage merchants into a pilot.

The company says ARCS generates localized copy and product imagery for Hong Kong consumers, with prompts and campaign templates.

Campaigns include a Payment Asia payment link; MHI separately scores merchant health using business and transaction-related data.

Hong Kong SMEs can assess the content-to-payment journey alongside creative review, payment tracking and data-use terms.

Ask about pilot eligibility, pricing and data requirements, then validate a small campaign and its payment journey.

The pilot is not universal availability. Sales impact and health-score predictive accuracy have not been independently tested.

items.title: Cordial推出Headless CDP，讓行銷團隊在AI助手內查詢客戶資料
items.title_en: Cordial launches a headless CDP for customer-data access in AI assistants
items.summary: Cordial於10月29日宣布Headless CDP，稱行銷團隊可透過Claude、ChatGPT、Microsoft Copilot或自建代理探索及視覺化即時客戶資料。
items.summary_en: Cordial announced its headless CDP on October 29, saying marketers can explore and visualize real-time customer data from Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot or custom agents.
items.why: 價值在於減少資料與操作介面分散；導入仍要清楚界定讀取權限、指標定義及可執行動作。
items.why_en: Teams can assess reduced interface fragmentation while defining data permissions, metric definitions and permitted actions.
items.next_step: 先選一條唯讀受眾查詢，對照CDP原始結果，再考慮開放活動建立或發送權限。
items.next_step_en: Start with a read-only audience query, compare it with the CDP’s source result, then consider activation permissions.
highlights: 公告把這次推出定位為六月headless AI基建的延伸，而非整個平台首次推出。
公司列出受眾分析、下一步行動建議，以及與商務及分析系統資料配合的用途。
highlights_en: The release builds on June’s headless AI infrastructure rather than marking the platform’s first launch.
The company describes audience analysis, next-action recommendations and combining commerce and analytics data.
items.detail:
Cordial於10月29日宣布Headless CDP，稱行銷團隊可透過Claude、ChatGPT、Microsoft Copilot或自建代理探索及視覺化即時客戶資料。

公告把這次推出定位為六月headless AI基建的延伸，而非整個平台首次推出。

公司列出受眾分析、下一步行動建議，以及與商務及分析系統資料配合的用途。

價值在於減少資料與操作介面分散；導入仍要清楚界定讀取權限、指標定義及可執行動作。

先選一條唯讀受眾查詢，對照CDP原始結果，再考慮開放活動建立或發送權限。

功能按Cordial公告歸因；並未測試資料延遲、收入效果或各AI助手帳戶的實際接入資格。
items.detail_en:
Cordial announced its headless CDP on October 29, saying marketers can explore and visualize real-time customer data from Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot or custom agents.

The release builds on June’s headless AI infrastructure rather than marking the platform’s first launch.

The company describes audience analysis, next-action recommendations and combining commerce and analytics data.

Teams can assess reduced interface fragmentation while defining data permissions, metric definitions and permitted actions.

Start with a read-only audience query, compare it with the CDP’s source result, then consider activation permissions.

Capabilities are attributed to Cordial; latency, revenue impact and account-level eligibility were not tested.

items.title: 騰訊發布Buddy One，以WorkBuddy串連辦公工具與儲存

內容按大會發言歸因；報道未提供完整香港開放名單、價格或所有企業帳戶條款，本刊未測試。

items.title: Gemini加入檔案預覽與直接編輯，PDF支援網頁及手機
items.title_en: Gemini adds in-chat file preview and editing, with PDFs on web and mobile

items.summary_en: Google announced file creation, preview and direct editing in Gemini on October 29. PDF preview and editing support web and mobile; other listed formats are web-only.

items.title: OpenAI重整Model Spec，明示人類意圖、透明度與代理行動原則
items.title_en: OpenAI reorganizes its Model Spec around intent, transparency and human agency
items.summary: OpenAI於10月29日更新公開Model Spec，將模型行為指引按五項價值重整，並增加情境、監督及人的自主性相關指引。
items.summary_en: OpenAI updated its public Model Spec on October 29, organizing behavior guidance around five values and adding guidance on context, oversight and human agency.
items.why: 使用AI代理的行銷團隊可把透明度、授權範圍及副作用提示轉成實際驗收案例。
items.why_en: Marketing teams using agents can turn transparency, authorization boundaries and side-effect communication into acceptance cases.
items.next_step: 選取一次改稿、一次資料不足及一次外部動作情境，檢查模型是否說明限制並遵守授權。
items.next_step_en: Review a revision task, an evidence gap and an external action for clear limitations and adherence to authorization.
highlights: 五項價值涵蓋忠於人類意圖、減少傷害、誠實透明、人的自主性及關懷。
更新擴充副作用控制與溝通，並撤除大部分詳細風格指引；OpenAI明言模型尚未完全符合規範。
highlights_en: The values cover faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care.
The revision expands side-effect guidance and retires much detailed style advice; OpenAI says models do not yet fully reflect the Spec.
items.detail:
OpenAI於10月29日更新公開Model Spec，將模型行為指引按五項價值重整，並增加情境、監督及人的自主性相關指引。

五項價值涵蓋忠於人類意圖、減少傷害、誠實透明、人的自主性及關懷。

更新擴充副作用控制與溝通，並撤除大部分詳細風格指引；OpenAI明言模型尚未完全符合規範。

使用AI代理的行銷團隊可把透明度、授權範圍及副作用提示轉成實際驗收案例。

選取一次改稿、一次資料不足及一次外部動作情境，檢查模型是否說明限制並遵守授權。

這是預期行為規範更新，並非新模型全面推出，亦不構成所有現有輸出均符合指引的證明。
items.detail_en:
OpenAI updated its public Model Spec on October 29, organizing behavior guidance around five values and adding guidance on context, oversight and human agency.

The values cover faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care.

The revision expands side-effect guidance and retires much detailed style advice; OpenAI says models do not yet fully reflect the Spec.

Marketing teams using agents can turn transparency, authorization boundaries and side-effect communication into acceptance cases.

Review a revision task, an evidence gap and an external action for clear limitations and adherence to authorization.

This is intended-behavior guidance, not a new model launch or proof that every current response complies.

items.detail_en:

items.title: 案例回看：Adobe與Alpine擬於2027賽季推AI粉絲體驗
items.title_en: Case recap: Adobe and Alpine plan AI fan experiences from the 2027 season
items.summary: Adobe與BWT Alpine Formula One Team於10月22日公布合作，Adobe成為車隊官方AI粉絲體驗夥伴，相關體驗計劃由2027賽季起推進。
items.summary_en: Adobe and BWT Alpine Formula One Team announced a partnership on October 22, with Adobe becoming its Official AI Fan Experience Partner and experiences planned from the 2027 season.
items.why: 這個具日期的案例呈現創意、數據、AI搜尋與粉絲參與如何連成同一方案，可供品牌合作規劃參考。
items.why_en: This dated case connects creative, data, AI search and participation within one partnership plan.
items.next_step: 品牌可先畫出內容製作、粉絲授權、互動及量度四個環節，再設定各階段可驗收的指標。
items.next_step_en: Map content production, fan consent, engagement and measurement, then define an acceptance metric for each.
highlights: 合作列明使用GenStudio製作內容，以及Experience Platform整理粉絲互動資料。
車隊亦計劃使用Brand Visibility觀察AI搜尋曝光，並透過Adobe Express讓粉絲創作分享內容。

They also include Brand Visibility for AI-search presence and Adobe Express for fan-created content.

Adobe與BWT Alpine Formula One Team於10月22日公布合作，Adobe成為車隊官方AI粉絲體驗夥伴，相關體驗計劃由2027賽季起推進。

合作列明使用GenStudio製作內容，以及Experience Platform整理粉絲互動資料。

車隊亦計劃使用Brand Visibility觀察AI搜尋曝光，並透過Adobe Express讓粉絲創作分享內容。

這個具日期的案例呈現創意、數據、AI搜尋與粉絲參與如何連成同一方案，可供品牌合作規劃參考。

品牌可先畫出內容製作、粉絲授權、互動及量度四個環節，再設定各階段可驗收的指標。

items.detail_en:
Adobe and BWT Alpine Formula One Team announced a partnership on October 22, with Adobe becoming its Official AI Fan Experience Partner and experiences planned from the 2027 season.

The plans name GenStudio for content and Experience Platform for fan-engagement data.

They also include Brand Visibility for AI-search presence and Adobe Express for fan-created content.

This dated case connects creative, data, AI search and participation within one partnership plan.

Map content production, fan consent, engagement and measurement, then define an acceptance metric for each.

This is a dated case recap, not a new announcement. Execution and outcomes remain ahead; no AI-driven audience or revenue uplift is established.

items.title: Google公布Gemini 4 Carbon，先向部分網路防禦團隊開放
items.title_en: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon with limited initial access for cyber defenders
items.summary: Google於10月28日公布Gemini 4 Carbon，聚焦軟體工程、長流程代理及網路防禦；初期向部分防禦團隊開放，再透過Fairwind計劃逐步擴展至可信夥伴。
items.summary_en: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon on October 28 for software engineering, sustained agent workflows and cyber defense, with initial access for selected defenders before phased trusted-partner access through Fairwind.
items.why: 對開發行銷代理或內部工具的團隊，模型進展值得追蹤，現階段仍應按實際可取得的版本規劃。
items.why_en: Teams building marketing agents or internal tools can monitor progress while planning around versions they can actually access.
items.next_step: 保留現有正式可用流程，待確認存取資格、價格條款與資料處理安排，再安排同任務比較。
items.next_step_en: Keep currently available workflows, then compare equivalent tasks once access, pricing terms and data handling are confirmed.
highlights: 一般開發者、企業及消費者的產品接入仍待後續開放。
官方公布多項基準及內部使用結果；本刊未重現評測，亦未把模型表現外推至行銷成效。
highlights_en: Broader product access for developers, businesses and consumers remains forthcoming.
Google reports benchmarks and internal usage results; these were not reproduced or extrapolated to marketing outcomes.
items.detail:
Google於10月28日公布Gemini 4 Carbon，聚焦軟體工程、長流程代理及網路防禦；初期向部分防禦團隊開放，再透過Fairwind計劃逐步擴展至可信夥伴。

一般開發者、企業及消費者的產品接入仍待後續開放。

官方公布多項基準及內部使用結果；本刊未重現評測，亦未把模型表現外推至行銷成效。

對開發行銷代理或內部工具的團隊，模型進展值得追蹤，現階段仍應按實際可取得的版本規劃。

保留現有正式可用流程，待確認存取資格、價格條款與資料處理安排，再安排同任務比較。

這是有限初期推出，並非面向所有品牌的現成工具；基準分數與速度、可靠性保證均不作本刊結論。
items.detail_en:
Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon on October 28 for software engineering, sustained agent workflows and cyber defense, with initial access for selected defenders before phased trusted-partner access through Fairwind.

Broader product access for developers, businesses and consumers remains forthcoming.

Google reports benchmarks and internal usage results; these were not reproduced or extrapolated to marketing outcomes.

Teams building marketing agents or internal tools can monitor progress while planning around versions they can actually access.

Keep currently available workflows, then compare equivalent tasks once access, pricing terms and data handling are confirmed.

This is limited initial access, not a ready tool for every brand. Benchmark leadership and reliability are not independently established here.
